title: Large Field-Free Superconducting Diode Effect with Nonmonotonic Polarity Reversals in NbSe2/CrBr3 Heterostructures
why_careful: Three devices (#1 to #3), field-history training in both directions, zero-field rectification after ±6 T magnetization, RMCD magnetic characterization, and supplementary checks against self-fields, Meissner screening and geometric asymmetry.

spans: Other trivial mechanisms for the zero-field SDE (e.g.,
self-fields, Meissner screening, and geometric asymmetry) are
ruled out, as shown in SM [40].
info.why: these are the only places the paper says Meissner screening, self-fields and geometric asymmetry were ruled out for the zero-field diode
